title: Nightmares: definition
description: Nightmares are distressing dreams that wake the sleeper, most common in the second half of the night.

title: Sleep science
description: Nightmares arise from REM sleep with heightened emotional arousal.

title: Imagery rehearsal
description: The dreamer rewrites the nightmare's script while awake, rehearsing the new version.

title: Lucid responses
description: Lucidity can transform nightmares: recognizing the dream defuses its terror.

title: Reported accounts
description: Common reported themes: chases, falls, being unprepared, losing teeth.

title: Dream options set
description: Options include: rehearsal rewrite, lucid confrontation, protective figures, and safe-place anchors.

title: Cautions
description: Frequent distressing nightmares deserve professional support.

title: Crossover notes
description: Nightmare options cross with mechanics: journaling and rehearsal are the core tools.
